parts.text: We are excited to announce a new tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Creative Technology & Design at the ATLAS Institute at CU Boulder, with a tenure home in Mechanical Engineering! We are seeking candidates whose work crosses boundaries—from soft and wearable robotics to smart textiles, physical computing, and dynamic interfaces. Learn more about the role, key research areas, and how to apply here:

>

The ATLAS Institute at the University of Colorado Boulder invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor in creative technology and design. We seek an imaginative, collaborative, and boundary-pushing scholar whose work transcends traditional disciplinary boundaries and engages deeply with technology, design, and human experience. The successful candidate will lead a forward-looking and externally funded research agenda, teach across ATLAS’s undergraduate and graduate programs, and contribute meaningfully to the institute’s interdisciplinary community. The position will have a tenure home in the Mechanical Engineering department. We welcome candidates whose work connects with existing ATLAS strengths while also introducing new directions. Example areas include, but are not limited to:

* Bio-inspired & miniature robotics, compliant actuation, soft robotics, and muscle-tendon locomotion for dynamic systems.
* Wearable robotics, exoskeletons, prosthetics, flexible/printed electronics, electronic skin, and adaptive human-assistive platforms.
* Medical & surgical manipulators, physical human–machine interaction, sensorimotor control, bio-sensing, and safe soft-tissue intervention.
* Smart textiles, soft/animate materials, and functional bio-wearables bridging digital fabrication, molecular/tattoo interfaces, and interactive crafts.
* Dynamic shape-changing interfaces, programmable materials, spatial/environmental sensing, and tangible/AR-VR physical computing.
Please share with colleagues and prospective applicants!
